mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum receipt 0xbeef088055857739c12cd3765f20b7679def0f51 is an immutable Morpho VaultV2 USDC lending position. Content as of 2026-10-20: C13 rechecked runtime and permanently abdicated local transfer gates at Ethereum block 26236622. User deposits fund proportional shares; interest and fee-share accrual alter NAV and borrower losses remain possible. The holder claim is residual code-enforced NAV redemption, not ownership of Circle reserves. This sourced departure from the fiat-cash parent establishes protocol-position identity; it grants no legal segregation, independent child assurance or guaranteed stressed cash exit.
